relevance_note: Case series of PSTPIP1 mutation carriers with individual-level detail: "Patients 1, 3, and 4 had the previously reported heterozygous mutation c.688G > A".
method_note: Read the full paper and Table 1 by hand; a short Python script in the scratch directory assembled the rows from hand-typed values and verified every span verbatim. Table 1 has patients as rows with a 'Patient' column of bare numbers 1-5; the text labels them 'Patient 1'..'Patient 5', which is used (rule 1). Scope: the 5 described patients plus three individually identifiable relatives of Patient 3 (his mother, his maternal uncle, and sibling II3), each stated to carry a PSTPIP1 mutation with no variant printed (variant rows kept as 'not reported'). The paper says PSTPIP1 mutations were found in 11 individuals from 4 kindreds; the remaining mutation-positive siblings of Patient 3 are described only as counts ('3 siblings had eczema', 'Arthritis occurred in 6 of the family members') and get no rows. Contradiction: Table 1 lists 'PG' for patient 4, but the text says 'He has not had PG or pathergy' and 'PG has occurred only in the proband’s uncle'; both PG rows emitted and checklist PG left not reported for Patient 4. Table 1 also omits acne for patient 4 while the text reports cystic acne. Inheritance left 'not reported' for Patients 3 and 4: the mother is stated to have 'confirmed mutations in PSTPIP1' but the paper does not say it is the same variant. is_proband left null for Patients 1, 2 and 5: the Discussion says '4 (including 3 probands)' without naming them. Elevated CRP and neutrophil granule proteins were recorded for patients 1, 2 and 5 as 'inferred from group statement' (group named: 'patients 1, 2, and 5'; group comparison against controls; Figure 2 says 'Levels of all analytes were significantly elevated in the patients'). Plasma IL-1β (marginally elevated) and PBMC cytokine findings were group-level and not recorded per person. 'Levels of complement factors 3 and 4 were normal' does not name which patients, so not recorded. Normal CD4/CD8/CD57 percentages for patients 1, 3, 4 not recorded as separate rows. Autoantibody negativity was recorded per patient from 'negative in all patients' (named group = the 5 patients). Patient 2's growth retardation was a complication of high-dose corticosteroids; checklist growth failure marked observed. Patient 1's colonic inflammation was caused by dapsone; checklist colitis marked observed. Recurrent otitis (Table 1 'Other clinical features') counted as recurrent infections for Patients 2 and 3. Patient 5: 'Cystic acne did not develop' excludes cystic acne but not the broader acne checklist item (left not reported). II3 'remained asymptomatic' recorded as a general row only; specific checklist items not excluded by it (PG excluded only via the uncle-only group statement). Patient 1 was previously reported (ref 13, 'streaking leukocyte factor disease'). Protein changes are printed only in one-letter form (A230T, E250Q, E250K) and recorded as printed in protein_hgvs_as_stated.
